entities.text: Crystal veins in the walls hum faintly. The light has no source.
A stone table. Six boxes — five already taken. The contestants ahead of you helped themselves.

A box bearing a familiar seal: HALVARD.

Inside: two gold pieces, and a note in a sharp hand — SUKUMVIT: 'The Trial wants useful things, not just strong arms. Carry what matters.'
A white arrow, painted fresh, points WEST. Below it, in charcoal: 'don't'.
Wet footprints — several sets — head west along the road.
One set of prints, smaller, goes east.

entities.intro: Something huge buzzes in the eastern dark. It smells of Water.

entities.text: A cold draught from the east, and a single small footprint pressed into the wet. Someone slight went this way and did not come back for their box.
An open box, its seal broken. Someone got here first — and went west.

entities.name: Old man
lines: One hundred? One hundred and fifty? Two hundred? Answer, if the stone lets you.

entities.text:
Not a statue. A knight in White Road armour, turned to stone mid-step.

Serra went first. This is where first got her.
A bronze bell on a rope. Ringing it would tell EVERYTHING down here where you are. You don't.
A chest, sprung and empty. The scratches around the lock are fresh.
A dry torch, still good. Someone thoughtful left it. Or careless.

entities.intro:
A Trialmastiff pads out of the dark, silent until it isn't.

One Ward slot. Water, by the drool.

entities.text: A deep pit. Black water far below. A rope is tied to a spike — the knots are barbarian work.

entities.name: Throm
lines: Only one of us wins this. Remember it while I hold the rope.

pit_ally: Lowered you fair. Don't make me regret it.
pit_jump: Ha! Mad. I like mad. West, then.

entities.text:
A red-bound book, chained to the alcove. It opens for you like it was waiting, and the diagram inside is of a hand with one more finger than yours.

Your weave can now hold FOUR spells.

A black-bound book. Beside it, a vial of something that moves when you don't look.

You take the vial.

entities.name: Throm
lines: Books. We don't have time for books.
Read the red one if you must. Quickly.

troll_down: ...My arm. Keep walking. Don't look at it.

entities.intro:
Two Cave Trolls blunder in, clubs up — and Throm is suddenly beside you, smelling of rope and anger.

"Mine's the big one," he says, and takes it.

Yours weaves Fire and Water behind two slots.

entities.text:
A druidic bone ring. Warm in a way bone should not be.

Throm: "Don't."

(You take it anyway. Nothing happens. Yet.)
A stone door with dwarfish locks. It is not for you. Yet.

entities.name: Dwarf
lines: John. And Throm. The Trialmaster at your service — locked doors are my speciality.

pit_betrayed: John. Alone. The Trialmaster at your service — locked doors are my speciality.
trial_ready: The cobra is ready. He waits in the arena. Finish it.
trial_done: The way is open. Go, and don't thank me.

entities.text: A stone table with two dice in a cup. Someone has been practising probabilities.

entities.intro:
They drag Throm into the arena. His eyes don't know you. The cobra's work.

"John?" he says. "No. Not John. FIGHT."

Three slots of barbarian fury — fast, and wrong. Defend yourself.

entities.text: A concealed tunnel breathes cold air from the south-west corner. The Dwarf's crossbow does not waver. Not yet.

text_run_flag.trial_done: The concealed tunnel in the south-west corner stands open. The Dwarf shrugs: 'Staff passage. Comes out by the lion-thing. Don't say I never gave you anything.'

entities.text:
An idol twice your height, jewel-eyed, bird-guarded. It is smiling the way doors smile.

Its left eye — your right, as you face it — is smaller, duller, and set deep. The other is enormous and catches the torchlight far too well. Around its base, in a dozen hands: WEST EYE. The rest of each sentence has been scratched out.

entities.intro:
The stuffed birds open their eyes. All of them.

Two Ward slots of whatever shines — read them like Ashby taught you.
The second guardian unfolds from the idol's shoulder.

entities.text:
The emerald eye comes away in your hand. It is heavier than a sin.

EMERALD acquired.
The east eye glitters. Bigger. Greener. The scratched warnings around the base were about this one.

entities.intro:
A Boa Constrictor is crushing an elven woman against the rocks. She sees you.

Three slots. Break it or bury her.

elf_gone: She is gone. The hollow smells of bread and dust.

entities.text:
Her bread, packed with healing herbs. You eat. The shaking stops.

(Your conditions are cleared.)
Her vine-charm. It curls around your wrist like it was always yours. Green things will know you carry it — and the snake did not like her for it.
The pool has an undertow. Something down there pulls east — a flooded passage, for anyone who can hold their breath long enough.

entities.travel_text: Reed between your teeth, you let the undertow take you. Drums, muffled by water, then air.

entities.text:
A box, an iron key, and a sapphire the size of a robin's egg.

SAPPHIRE acquired — and the key fits the northern lock.
A diamond beside a fallen warrior, just lying there. Every instinct says trap.
The inner vault door. Iron, keyed.

text_run_flag.vault_alarm: The inner vault door — bolted from inside since you touched the warrior's jewel. No key opens a bolt. The Basket man's rope might.

entities.travel_text: Down the rope-shaft, the basket swaying. The Basket man catches it without looking up.
Down the rope-shaft, the basket swaying. The Basket man catches it without looking up.

entities.text: A rope-shaft drops through the floor. Far below, someone whistles tunelessly and waits for a fare.

A diamond in a hall of echoes — real, cold, and yours.

DIAMOND acquired.

entities.name: Starved man
lines: ...failed... they took my eyes... no, my boots...

prisoner_free: Go. Stones. It loves... no. It HATES the green. Vine. Its eyes water.

entities.name: Poison Ivy
lines: Tribute, sweetling. Something useful, or thorns.

ivy_paid: Paid in full. Walk soft, sweetling.

entities.name: Basket man
lines: Up or down? I only work the rope. Don't ask about the screams.

basket_ok: Up, then. Mind your fingers on the way past the vault ceiling.

entities.travel_text: The basket creaks upward. Stone slides past your face for a long time.
The basket creaks upward. Stone slides past your face for a long time.

entities.text: A crawl-shaft climbs north. Small footprints on the rungs, going up. The assassin's way in — or out.
A duty roster, scratched in charcoal. Names, days, arrows. The Trial is somebody's job.
Tall mirrors, silver-backed. Something moves in them a breath after you do.

entities.intro:
What steps out of the glass is made of looking back.

Three slots of reflected things — never what it casts. (Or smash the mirrors instead.)

entities.text:
A shard of mirror-light. It wants to be a spell.

You have learned LIGHT magic.

Bitter herbs, chewed and spat out. Something with a tongue hates Vine the way fire hates water.

(Bloodbeast weakness learned: no Vine in its Ward.)

entities.intro:
Four slots of hunger unhinge the dark.

Break it — and what it was will teach you Shadow.

grant_on_win.text:
The beast dissolves into its own shadow, and the shadow stays.

You have learned SHADOW magic.

entities.intro:
The floor breathes. Then it opens.

Blind, heat-sensing, enormous. Three slots — and it can smell your torch.

entities.text: A side tunnel slopes down into the dark. Dust falls in a steady trickle, and the floor here is scored with one long, round-bottomed groove. Something heavy has come down this slope before.
Scratches in the stone floor around the chest: a fan of gouges, all the same length, all pointing outward. Whatever the lid does, it does it fast and low.
An iron-bound chest, lid a finger's width open. Gold glints inside. So does something else, at floor height.

entities.name: Ritual elder
lines: The rite, stranger. Dance it, run it, or bleed it. The tribe does not mind which.

trog_rite: Danced. Witnessed. Go with wet feet, stranger.

entities.text: A bridge of black stone over black water. Drums on the far side.
The river pulls hard. A hollow reed-tube bobs against the bank — somebody escaped this way once.
A hollow tube, wax-sealed at both ends. For breathing underwater, if it comes to that.

entities.travel_text: You bite the reed, fill your chest, and go under. The current does the rest. You come up in colder, quieter water.

entities.text: A narrow staff passage climbs north — swept, lamplit, and clearly not meant for contestants.

text_run_flag.trial_done: The Dwarf's staff passage. It runs back to the Trialmaster's complex, for anyone he has decided to like.

entities.intro:
The last gate has teeth, wings, and patience.

Four slots. It has been waiting longer than you.

The Red Wizard is already here, picking his teeth.

"The woodcutter. Still counting? Four knots, then — settle it, or walk past."

entities.name: Igbut
lines: Three gems, contestant. Emerald. Sapphire. Diamond. The door does the rest.

entities.text: A door of black stone with three empty sockets, gem-sized, in a row.
The Emerald, chipped now, under the plinth.
The Sapphire, against the far wall.
The Diamond, cold as ever, by your boot.
